_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 and already repricing obvious losers (Chegg, 2023-05-02), but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 26.8x FY23E — a premium, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting deflation or GenAI shows up as shrinking billable hours.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.80x; +49% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.46; conservative 2yr -7%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (the decade's worst year, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (decade CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run of the decade); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-06-09) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.80x (34.6% downside to Bear $202 / +19.2% upside to Bull $368) | Adj composite 2.89 vs market 3.35: gap -0.46 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +49% above the EPP floor $207 (18x FY23E $11.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: -6.9% total (-3.4%/yr) | At 26.8x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $408 sits above the BULL case; consulting +4% LC in Q2, Q3 guided +3-7% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
